items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: We did quite a bit of recording too... I was furious with Slam because I'd left him... I'm still with Slam.

ctx.x: Slam Stewart. Slam was very big then too, incidently, and he did some very good things. We did quite a bit of recording too, incidently. On what labels?

items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: John Collins. And quite a few other musicians at times when we were at one or the other's house... Tiny used to play with us... John Collins.

ctx.x: And like did you know John Collins, the guitarist John Collins?
Because he was with -- he was with -- at after Tiny had left, Johnny joined Tatum and myself.
